Why won't this egg stay stopped?
It's not a sloppy stop.
A boiled egg,
stopped the same way,
stays still.
Look inside.
Your finger only stopped
the shell.
The runny inside keeps
swirling,
and when you let go,
it drags the shell back around.
A boiled egg is solid,
so it all stops at once.
Why won't this egg stay stopped?
